text: The Secret on a Snowy Night
Something happened in Tomte Pavilion and because of that,\nXmas energy cannot be transmitted. In order to discover the\ncause, first, find the ladder to 2F!
A cat-like creature in the pavilion is setting\ntricks to stop you from progressing.\nFind the ladder to 3F!
Yule Cat, a suspicious cat, and some monsters\nare blocking the way to the top floor.\nDefeat them and find the ladder to the top floor!
With the key that Velly brought, you can go straight\nto the top floor from the middle room. Defeat Yule Cat in\norder to enable the transmission of Xmas energy!
Santa Potum took the Holy Stones that control Xmas energy\nsomewhere. Find and collect Holy Stones to replace the\nmissing ones in order to power the establishment!
[[N]]Find the ladder to Tomte Pavilion: Top Floor!
